observe.why: to know when the job started, resumed and ended
to show which step is running, who works on it and how far along the plan it is
to count the decisions waiting on you
to show what the checks found, and when a result was reused from an earlier step
to add up the time and the cost
to show the rigor the QE plan set at intake
to show the rigor history: each change, what triggered it and the score
to show the checkpoints of a power-mode build
to show which orchestrator turn is running
to show where the hand-off is: checks, review, QE and compliance
to know when power mode is switched on or off

permissions.why: to show the job's working document and who changed what
to save what you type in it (yours, steering the next step) and to add its own lines under Decisions (labelled as the plugin's)
to suggest a note for the next step; nothing is sent until you press Send
